title: Annapurna Base Camp
shortDescription: A classic Himalayan sanctuary trek amphitheatred by 7000m peaks.
description: The Annapurna Base Camp trek leads into a natural amphitheatre of soaring peaks, passing terraced farmland, rhododendron forest and Gurung villages before reaching the glacial basin at 4,130m.

itinerary.title: Pokhara to Nayapul, trek to Tikhedhunga
itinerary.description: Drive to the trailhead and a gentle first walk along the Modi Khola.

itinerary.title: Tikhedhunga to Ghorepani
itinerary.description: Steep stone staircase through forest to the ridge village of Ghorepani.

itinerary.title: Poon Hill sunrise, trek to Tadapani
itinerary.description: Pre-dawn climb for panoramic Annapurna and Dhaulagiri views.

title: Everest Base Camp
shortDescription: Iconic trek to the foot of the world's highest peak.
description: The trek to Everest Base Camp winds through Sherpa villages, pine forests and glacial valleys, acclimatising at Namche before reaching Base Camp and the Kala Patthar viewpoint.

itinerary.title: Fly to Lukla, trek to Phakding
itinerary.description: Scenic mountain flight, then a gentle downhill walk to Phakding.

itinerary.title: Trek to Namche Bazaar
itinerary.description: Climb through pine forest to the bustling Sherpa capital.

itinerary.title: Acclimatisation day at Namche
itinerary.description: Short hike to Everest View Hotel to aid acclimatisation.

title: Markha Valley
shortDescription: Remote teahouse trek through Ladakh's high desert villages.
description: The Markha Valley trek crosses high passes and river fords through one of Ladakh's most remote inhabited valleys, with homestays, gompas and views of Kang Yatse.

itinerary.title: Leh to Chilling, trek to Skiu
itinerary.description: Drive along the Indus, cross the Markha river and walk to Skiu.

itinerary.title: Skiu to Markha
itinerary.description: Long valley walk past chortens and river crossings.

itinerary.title: Markha to Thachungtse
itinerary.description: Ascend with first views of Kang Yatse.

title: Hampta Pass
shortDescription: A dramatic crossover trek from green Kullu to barren Lahaul.
description: Hampta Pass is a classic crossover trek where lush green Kullu valley gives way abruptly to the stark high-altitude desert of Lahaul, with an optional side trip to Chandratal lake.

itinerary.title: Manali to Jobra, trek to Chika
itinerary.description: Short drive then easy walk into the meadows of Chika.

itinerary.title: Cross Hampta Pass to Shea Goru
itinerary.description: Steep climb to the 4,270m pass and a sharp descent into Lahaul.

title: Kedarkantha
shortDescription: India's most loved winter snow-trek to a 3,810m summit.
description: Kedarkantha is the quintessential beginner winter summit, with snow-laden pine forests, frozen clearings and a sunrise summit push offering a 360-degree Himalayan panorama.

itinerary.title: Dehradun to Sankri
itinerary.description: Long scenic drive to the base village of Sankri.

itinerary.title: Sankri to Juda ka Talab
itinerary.description: Forest trail to a frozen alpine lake.

itinerary.title: Summit day to Kedarkantha peak
itinerary.description: Pre-dawn snow climb to the 3,810m summit for sunrise.
